climbs_list.name: Le Salève - Col de la Croisette

story: The stage featured numerous early attacks, with 24 riders eventually breaking away, controlled by Visma | Lease a Bike. Mauro Schmid attacked in the descent, while key chasers Simmons and Pidcock were eventually caught. Jonas Vingegaard abandoned following a crash. Pogačar took over at the front on the final climb, setting a pace that only Evenepoel and Del Toro could follow. Del Toro launched a late attack, but Evenepoel won the sprint ahead of Pogačar.
